## Notebooks

The workshop notebook, ready to run in Colab:

[Open the workshop notebook](https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1vA2f-xUFraQ2zemvNmVe3jslkZlpNzr7?usp=sharing)

Use File → Save a copy in Drive to get your own editable copy.

To run it on your own machine instead:

1. <a href="assets/theorymethod_workshop_notebook.ipynb" download>Download the notebook</a> (9.8 MB).
2. Make a folder for the workshop and put the notebook in it.
3. Open that folder in VS Code or Jupyter, then open the notebook.

Work from that folder throughout. The papers you download and the files the
pipeline writes all land there.

## Installation

Two separate packages, one for each half of the day. Both need **Python 3.11 or newer**.

**For downloading papers** (morning):
[tmsr-doi-downloader](https://pypi.org/project/tmsr-doi-downloader/), from the eScience
Center:

```bash
pip install tmsr-doi-downloader
```

**For the causal map** (afternoon):
[theoryminer](https://pypi.org/project/theoryminer/):

```bash
pip install theoryminer
```

In a notebook or Colab, put a `%` in front: `%pip install theoryminer`.

### One key to set

The downloader's Unpaywall source needs an email address, in a `.env` file in your working
directory:

```
UNPAYWALL_EMAIL=your.email@example.com
```

No GPU needed. In Colab, Runtime → Change runtime type → T4 GPU is faster and free.
